label: wordmark or nameplate pendant in plain metal (no stones)
construction: A nameplate style pendant: the letters or mark are cut from one sheet of metal and are physically joined to each other by a continuous base bar or by touching letterforms, so the whole pendant is one rigid piece. A small bail at each end of the piece; a fine chain passes through both bails. No letter hangs on its own.
photo: Studio product photograph, soft even lighting, white seamless background, subtle shadow, the pendant centered with the chain visible above it, no text, no people, no props.
